BiblicalUsage: Taralah was a town in the territory of Benjamin, named in the list of the cities given to the tribe. Its name means reeling, and it stands among the towns that marked Benjamin's inheritance.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that even a town named once, in one list, is part of the land God gave, and no inheritance is too small to record.
